div.p: 3-day immersive certification training in neurogenic tremoring, nervous system regulation and somatic self-care — for coaches, therapists, and healthcare professionals. 21 ICF CCEUs. Taught in English (also translated into Romanian).

p.span: Thursday, 15 October 2026 · Introductory Evening 17:00–19:00 EET · Bucharest

div.p: TRE™ (Tension, Stress & Trauma Releasing Exercises) is a simple yet powerful body-based tool, developed by Dr. David Berceli, that activates a natural neurogenic tremoring mechanism to help discharge accumulated stress, tension and trauma from the nervous system.

Module 1 is the foundational certification level, giving you an in-depth theoretical understanding and supervised hands-on experience of TRE™ — equipping you to integrate neurogenic tremoring safely into your professional practice and personal self-care.

This is the first time TRE™ Module 1 is offered in Europe in English, opening the certification pathway to international coaches, therapists, and healthcare professionals based in or visiting Romania.

ul.li: Executive, life and business coaches seeking somatic tools
Therapists, counsellors and psychologists
Healthcare professionals, nurses and allied health practitioners
Yoga, Pilates and movement teachers and trainers
HR professionals and organisational wellbeing leads
Anyone working with stress, trauma and resilience professionally

div.div:
Introductory Evening
Self-Care and Presence for Coaches

ul.li: Welcome, introductions and context setting
Introduction to TRE™ — neuroscience, stress biology and the tremor mechanism
Live TRE™ session experience (guided by Isabelle and Saymara)
Q&A, integration and close

div.div: This evening is also the From Shaking to Shaping Bucharest in-person session — participants may register for the workshop standalone or as part of this Module 1 training.

ul.li: Morning grounding and review of Day 1 experience
Nervous system anatomy: autonomic nervous system, polyvagal theory, and the stress response cycle
TRE™ protocol deep dive: the 7 exercises, facilitation cues and modifications
Lunch break
Supervised practice pairs: facilitating TRE™ with a partner
Contraindications, safety and professional boundaries
Afternoon TRE™ group session
Integration, discussion and reflection circles
Morning check-in and overnight integration shares
Group facilitation practice — working with more complex presentations
Integrating TRE™ into your practice context (coaching, therapy, group settings)
Lunch break
Supervised self-practice and peer coaching with TRE™
Case study discussions and scope-of-practice framework
Module 1 completion, next steps to Module 2, and certification path overview
Closing ceremony and celebration
2.5 training days in person (22 contact hours including the introductory evening)
21 ICF Continuing Coach Education (CCE) units
Official TRE™ Module 1 certificate of completion
Full TRE™ protocol manual and participant workbook
Guided audio recordings for continued home practice
Post-training Zoom integration call (1 hour, within 4 weeks)
Access to the TRE™ Module 1 alumni community
Pathway to Module 2 & Global TRE™ Provider Certification

div.div:
21 ICF CCEUs Approved
This training qualifies for 21 ICF Continuing Coach Education credits (Resource Development). Certificates are issued directly by Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer Isabelle Claus Teixeira. Keep your ICF credential current while deepening your somatic toolkit.

div.p: 20 tickets in total, released in three waves — the price steps up as each wave sells out. All prices per person and include the 3-day training, 21 ICF CCEUs, all training materials and the post-training integration call.
Availability shown is updated by our team — final availability is always confirmed at checkout in the official webshop.

Join the international network of TRE™ certified providers

div.p: Isabelle runs Modules 1–3 in Singapore. Contact her if you wish to complete your certification pathway in Asia.

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC
div.p: Somatic and Trauma-informed Executive Coach (ICF PCC), Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and Mindfulness Teacher. Trained directly under Dr. David Berceli, founder of TRE™. Over 30 years of experience coaching leaders across 9 countries and 40+ nationalities. Based in Singapore.

div.span: Certified TRE™ Provider & Trainer Trainee · Bucharest
div.p: Founder & President, Asociația TRE™ România. Holistic Coach, Trainer & Mentor, and Certified TRE™ Provider currently in the Trainer Trainee program. The pioneer who introduced TRE™ to Romania, Saymara brings deep local knowledge of the somatic and coaching landscape in Eastern Europe.

div.div: In collaboration with: Învață să Zbori SRL (Learn to Fly) · TRE™ România · BHD Asia

div.p: This Module 1 training took place in Bucharest on 15–17 October 2026.

div.div: Also attending From Shaking to Shaping? The Oct 15 introductory evening is the same as the From Shaking to Shaping Bucharest Session 2 (20 Oct). If you register for Module 1, the Shaking to Shaping workshop is included at no extra cost.
